note: high/low name the conversion label only. conversion = followers/views, so no pair with a real label gap can balance both popularity covariates; the strata carry the confound in opposite directions instead. `aligned` has every prose-blind popularity rule pointing at the label and `crossed` has every one pointing away, so no single fixed rule clears 0.50 in both. The bar is the minimum across strata, never the mean.
